name: HolyMind Quiet Current
scope: Listening prototype on Hero → orbit → ribbon → pinned Assemble. New channels fade out below the assembly; fourteen original tap sounds remain available elsewhere.

features.ambient: New quiet electric field: low stable partials, filtered seeded texture and slow asynchronous modulation; no leading melody or repeated tap samples.
features.scroll: New continuous filament follows trusted native wheel, touch, keyboard and manual range gestures. Smoothed bounded speed, direction hysteresis, and continuous pre-rounded assembly progress. Down opens; up gathers; pause fades only current.
features.mix: One AudioContext; separate field/current/resolve buses alongside unchanged Electric v12 taps. Tap ducking reduces the two background buses then restores them.
features.assembly: Four reused tap milestones replaced by a new soft completion cue and a quieter reconnect cue, with boundary hysteresis and cooldown.
features.control: Sound mix contains independent Background ambience and Scroll response toggles, plus persistent master mute/volume. No Motion toggle. Visuals remain always-on.
features.lifecycle: No audio context or playback on load/scroll alone. A tap starts sound. Hidden/interrupted pages stop all sound; returning requires an explicit new gesture. No missed-event replay.
features.intent: Anchor jumps, resize, unprompted scripted scrolling and layout changes do not create scroll swooshes.
features.comparison: Studio uses the actual live showcase for Taps only / Field + taps / Full mix at unchanged master level. Five 22-second WAVs render the same production graph, no per-file normalization.

preservation.pinned_assembly: 0 → 100 → 0, anchored leaders and existing controls retained
preservation.hero: Mobile-first brain only; desktop/tablet composition unchanged

sound_source: Original parameter-authored Web Audio synthesis. No stock samples, real-world recordings, generative-audio model, external audio service or new runtime dependency.
test_note: Tests wait for actual scroll/continuity settlement and observed native-input activity rather than taking fixed-delay snapshots. Playwright fill is not treated as proof of trusted input.

limitations.preview_method: Scripted OfflineAudioContext renders of the production graph, not microphone recordings.
